blocks.head: alt The user currently has permission at the cloud

state_rules.rule:
eq < cloudB | ('buffer' : nils , UserX : ('permission' : true , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'requestPublish' cloudB | ('toggle') 
= < cloudB | ('buffer' : 'toggle' , UserX : ('permission' : true , ..) , ...) > $ cloudB 'ackPublish' UserX | ('toggle') .

eq < cloudB | (UserX : ('permission' : true , ..) , ...) > $ cloudB 'revokePermission' cloudB | (UserX) 
= < cloudB | (UserX : ('permission' : false , ..) , ...) > .

eq < cloudB | ('buffer' : Msg , deviceA : ('permission' : true , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'requestRelease' cloudB 
= < cloudB | ('buffer' : nils , deviceA : ('permission' : true , ..) , ...) > $ cloudB 'deliver' deviceA | (Msg) .

eq < deviceA | ('on' : false , ..) > $ cloudB 'deliver' deviceA | ('toggle') 
= < deviceA | ('on' : true , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX) @ S < UserX | (..) > .

event_rules.label: rev2
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev2]: E @ S < cloudB | (UserX : ('permission' : true , ..) , ...) > 
=> ep: ev2(UserX) @ S < cloudB | (UserX : ('permission' : true , ..) , ...) > .

event_rules.label: rev3
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev3]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > 
=> ep: ev3(UserX) @ S < UserX | (..) > .
